rvice 2 / djying Category: Performance Software Primary Use: A completely free, open-source mixing environment for professional-level use. Why It Matters (2026): Offers unparalleled customization and freedom to build custom features without commercial lock-in. Notes: Works with a wide range of controllers and supports DVS setups.
Tool: Resolume Supports Services: Service 2 / djying Category: Visuals Primary Use: Creates reactive visual effects and backgrounds for LED booths and stages. Why It Matters (2026): Syncs visuals automatically based on the energy and rhythm of a live DJ set. Notes: Ideal for EDM and house DJs performing on large-scale stages with high-tech booths.
